interview.name: Sam
interview.answer: The time and place aren’t set yet; Vik said they’ll repeat the full details once they’re finalized.

reflections: Sam is consistently cooperative and quick to take on concrete task assignments.
Hana and Mara both delegate in a clear, practical way and follow through with specific next steps.
The repair drive work is being divided into small, well-defined pieces, suggesting a coordinated team effort.
Sam is a reliable organizer who takes clear ownership of sorting, labeling, and coordinating the repair-drive logistics.
Mara and Quinn are willing helpers who respond well to direct, concrete tasks and follow-through.
Cleo appears to handle coordination details like drop-off information and missing items, complementing Sam’s hands-on organizing role.
Sam is the main organizer and responds by assigning concrete, hands-on tasks to others.
Cleo and Oren are information coordinators, especially around drop-off details and missing items.
Mina is available for practical support and can be delegated sorting work.
Sam is coordinating concrete repair-drive tasks and keeps the group focused on next steps.
Oren and Vik are handling missing logistics details and time/place confirmations so the team can proceed.
Jules is aligned with Sam on sorting and triaging fixes, with a shared plan to match remaining work to the school pickup window.
Sam is the central coordinator, repeatedly organizing tasks and following up on lists, signups, and matching repairs to tools or parts.
The others are generally cooperative and take on concrete supporting roles like sorting donations, identifying needed fixes, and handling logistics.
The group works in a steady handoff pattern: one person sorts and inventories, another compiles the remaining needs, and Sam helps route the work to the right next step.
